name: learning-math
description: Math learning app — a fat organism whose orbitals are individual math topics, each composed via `uses` from a per-topic engine atom on the math-canvas.

vectors.label: Vectors
vectors.description: Initial vector scene in data coordinates; A is fixed, B oscillates, A+B is the tip-to-tail resultant.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick animates B's oscillation and updates the resultant; toggle to start/pause.

curves.label: Curves
curves.description: Initial pair of lines in data coordinates: A through (-3,-2), B through (3,2).

mB.label: Line B Slope
mB.description: Fixed slope of line B through data point (3,2); line A's slope animates and the intersection tracks it.

points.label: Points
points.description: Initial intersection point of the two lines in data coordinates.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick animates line A's slope and recomputes the intersection; toggle to start/pause.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick advances the phase and hops the marker to the next integer; toggle to start/pause.

points.label: Points
points.description: 19 gray integer tick dots along y=0 plus one bold red marker 'n' that hops between them each tick.

curves.label: Curves
curves.description: The number line itself: a single horizontal segment along y=0 from x=-9 to x=9 in data coordinates.

events.name: Sequence Updated
events.description: The current sequence scene each tick — a composed listener (readout, graph) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.

curves.label: Curves
curves.description: The connecting line through every term in data coordinates; its constant slope is the common difference d.

d.label: Common Difference
d.description: The constant step d between consecutive terms; a straight line of dots makes it visible as slope.

a0.label: First Term
a0.description: The first term a₀ of the arithmetic sequence; the marker term is recomputed as a₀ + n·d.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick sweeps the highlighted marker term-by-term along the sequence; toggle to start/pause.

points.label: Points
points.description: The nine static term dots {x:n, y:a₀+n·d} in data coordinates; the sweeping marker highlights the current one.

points.label: Points
points.description: 41 samples of y = 5·sin(x) across x in [-9, 9].
